added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the entry point resolves its checkout with `readlink -f "$0"` (plugins/crew-host/bin/crew-host:56) precisely because a personal-scope plugin loads as a symlink under ~/.claude/skills/, but _checkout copies the plugin and _launch runs the real path under the temp root, so the symlinked-invocation path is never exercised; I confirmed the behaviour is correct today (invoking through a symlinked plugin still execs the checkout with the right argv) yet mutating script_path="$0" exits 127 with no record while all 5 tests stay green, so a regression dropping readlink -f would leave the gate green.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 875c0f08f; three commits, five files, +332/-0, the plugin, one test module and one evidence fragment, with 9435a8b92 renaming the plugin for its skills-dir link, labelling the monitor and adding the FIFO teardown.
item_verdicts.done_when: §3's done-when names one idle shell process per session, no output in its pane, and exit within a minute of the session ending; tests/test_session_host_plugin.py asserts the FIFO appears at :124, silence at :131, first-request exec at :147, exit within one interval at :187 and FIFO removal at :201, and my own re-run of the gate at 9435a8b92 reads 5 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is the §3 deliverable, a personal-scope plugin at plugins/crew-host that waits silently on a node-local FIFO until asked and then becomes `reckon crew host`; plugins/crew-host/bin/crew-host:1 creates plugins/crew-host/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, plugins/crew-host/monitors/monitors.json (one monitor, when "always") and the entry point.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 567eca204, 0e19aa5b0 and 9435a8b92, changed_paths populated, negative_control_log names gate-negative-control.log whose last line is EXIT=1 with the two failing ids the head arm does not fail; baseline_suite/after_suite are empty, so the added-failure count is unmeasured rather than zero.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared write paths and the diff; all three commits touch only plugins/crew-host/{.claude-plugin/plugin.json,bin/crew-host,monitors/monitors.json}, tests/test_session_host_plugin.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-follower-lives-as-long-as-its-session/session-host-plugin-waits-silently.html, every one inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: the declared negative control (an echo before the wait loop) reddens tests/test_session_host_plugin.py:131 test_waits_silently_on_a_fifo_named_for_its_owner and :187 test_exits_within_one_interval_after_its_owner_exits at 2 failed EXIT=1, so the silence guard is falsified, and :201 test_removes_its_fifo_when_its_owner_exits fails if the teardown regresses.
justifications.evidence: gate-head.log records "5 passed in 4.21s" EXIT=0 at 9435a8b92, which I reproduced (5 passed EXIT=0), and gate-negative-control.log records 2 failed EXIT=1 whose ids are absent from the head arm; no base arm log exists so added_failure_count is unmeasured.
justifications.fit: plugins/crew-host/bin/crew-host:1 is a `set -u` shell entry point with mechanism comments, monitors/monitors.json matches the plugin monitor schema (`claude plugin validate plugins/crew-host --strict passed`, reproduced), and no added line carries a plan, version or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: plugins/crew-host/bin/crew-host:16 derives the owner pid/start pair, :30 selects the runtime dir, :44 opens the node-local FIFO and :55 execs the checkout's `.venv/bin/reckon crew host` with `--owner-pid/--owner-start/--fd 3/--first-request`, which are exactly the options reckon/cli.py:4928 crew_host accepts.
justifications.reuse: the entry point delegates the request protocol to the existing `reckon crew host` (integrated reckon/cli.py:4928, backed by reckon/crew/session_host.py:507) rather than re-reading the FIFO in shell, and duplicates only the /proc start-time parse, which a shell script cannot share with reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:271 across the language seam.
justifications.scope_discipline: `git diff --stat 875c0f08f..9435a8b92` is five files, +332/-0, all inside the manifest's changed_paths and none outside the node's declared write paths.
